name: The Savage
s: Based on true events, this gritty series follows a notorious Iranian fugitive who outsmarted authorities in a prolonged cat-and-mouse chase through the streets of Tehran.

paragraphs.text: The Savage (Persian: وحشی, romanized: Vahshi) is a 2025 Iranian television series created by Houman Seyyedi, and starring Javad Ezzati as the lead character. The first episode premiered on Filmnet on 14 April 2025.

The Savage won the awards for Best Television Series and Best Television Director (Houman Seyyedi) at the 24th Hafez Awards. The series also received nominations for Best Television Screenplay, Best Actor in a Television Drama (Javad Ezzati), and Best Actress in a Television Drama (Negar Javaherian), among other categories.
